TC-10/S14.title: Existing specs: pre-round medication merge rules (dose takes the row name, brand = generic, no row for an unnamed drug)
TC-10/S14.detail: Lane A on 43c38a4f (scripts/spec-matrix.mjs, Tim's tests by title from cases/e2e-titles.tsv regenerated for 43c38a4f; run under the local lock with the tripwire). api/medication-preround-merge.spec.ts 'G04 a dictated new dose takes over the row name; the old dose survives in the note', 'G54 brand on file, generic returned: one row', 'a drug the dictation never names is not added (prior-note echo)' and the same-titled medication-golden-set test all pass (AC 9, deterministic merge). Not covered by these rules tests, found by TC-10/S28: one 'as needed' drug in a dictated medication-list sentence makes the merge drop every drug of that sentence (new candidate).
